title: Starting state
summary: Before anything has run a machine case (no QA run, no plan result, not in a live roster), yoke qa requirement update --field starting_state re-declares it from one JSON object: baseline with a host_baseline. It rewrites in-flight admitted copies too. Afterwards it refuses starting_state_case_executed toward a corrected case and supersede; an item row materialized from a plan refuses starting_state_plan_owned toward the plan edit; inherit is declared only on a plan case. Each inherited chain runs with its head driver and union of declared hosts, acquired before the opener and retained through execution and review; independent chains sharing a driver within one execution reserve their combined hosts before the first capture, so later cases never expand a held set or mask a lost companion lease; changing the driver refuses inherited_driver_mismatch with the same-driver or new-chain repair. An exploratory mission may inherit at the tail only, in an isolated chain execution; no case may inherit after it. Item and deployment runs partition such chains automatically; standalone plans containing other chains refuse inherited_mission_requires_isolated_plan and teach a separate plan or scoped attachment. Prepare the mission session during the walk or in a preceding case in the same chain. Ask for password entry while holding the host lease. Host Commands, host_control cases, and missions declaring a Test Machine, OS, specific host capability or baseline require host starting state. Hostless missions need none and ignore run machine pins. A Command naming method_config.test_machine also declares a baseline or explicitly inherits from its predecessor. A chain head resets before work starts. A case needing Yoke on the host, including a mission verifying browser identities, requires shell-preconfigured.
